title: CHILURSO: Efficacy of Ursodeoxycholic Acid versus Corticosteroids for the Treatment of Cholestatic Hepatitis Secondary to Immunotherapy
official: Efficacy of Ursodeoxycholic Acid versus Corticosteroids for the Treatment of Cholestatic Hepatitis Secondary to Immunotherapy: A Multicenter, Controlled, Randomized, Open Trial
summary: Main objective: Compare the effectiveness of ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) to corticosteroids in treating cholestatic hepatitis induced by immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) over a 21-day period.
conditions: Cholestatic hepatitis induced by immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adults, 18 years old with any type of cancer except hepatocellular or cholangiocarcinoma
2. Any therapeutic line (adjuvant or palliative), at least one ICI injection
3. cholestatic hepatitis R≤ 2 (R=ratio (ALT/ULN) /(PAL/ULN)) , Grade CTC-AE 3 or 4.
4. Women of childbearing age using an appropriate contraceptive method throughout the entire duration of the treatment
Exclusion criteria:
1. Ongoing corticosteroids treatment
2. Pregnant and breastfeeding patients
3. other causes of hepatitis, cirrhosis
4. ICI for hepatocellular carcinoma or cholangiocarcinoma
5. biliary obstruction
6. medical contraindication to corticosteroids or UDCA   medical contraindication to MRI or liver biopsy
7. mixed or hepatocellular hepatitis,
8. total bilirubin > 1,5 ULN, prothrombin rate < 70%
9. other serious side effects requiring corticosteroids
10. patients under articles L1121-5 to 8 of the public health code, lack of informed consent, patients not affiliated with French social security system and patients uncapable of understanding/ reading/ writing in french
